summary: Implemented and exported `Perc` with percentile counts or explicit levels, NumPy method selection and version compatibility, orientation-aware grouped output, and support for missing observations. Added API examples, autosummary and release-note entries, plus focused stats tests. The focused tests passed (14 passed), and both `Dot + Perc` and `Range + Perc` rendered through `Plot.add`. The full suite had 1,784 passed, 81 skipped, and 6 xfailed; its one failure was the existing `TestFacetGrid.test_subplot_kws` expectation for a Matplotlib class name. `git diff --check` passed. No dependencies were added; the full suite was the only check that failed.
